description: This source file initializes the React application by rendering the 'App' component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It imports React, ReactDOM, a CSS stylesheet, and the main App component, then sets up the root rendering with React.StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root that manages the rendering of React components into a DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the specified root, starting with React.StrictMode and the App component.
